requirements.quote: Switchgear covered by these specifications will be installed on Logan City’s municipal power system to provide electrical service to residential, commercial and light industrial loads via the City’s distribution system.
requirements.text: Switchgear must serve Logan City's residential, commercial, and light industrial loads.

requirements.quote: Switchgear will be connected to one substation type transformer by overhead external rigid bus (by Owner). Switchgear shall include exterior roof top bushings and bus support insulators for external buswork to be connected to and supported above the switchgear building.
requirements.text: Switchgear must connect to a substation transformer and include rooftop bushings and bus support insulators.

requirements.quote: The switchgear described in this specification shall be designed for operation on a three-phase, four-wire, 60-hertz system.
requirements.text: Switchgear must operate on a three-phase, four-wire, 60 Hz system.

requirements.quote: The general configuration and certain ratings and requirements for switchgear are depicted on the attached layout drawings, which form a part of this specification.
requirements.text: Switchgear configuration and ratings are detailed in attached layout drawings.

requirements.quote: The following technical specification describes minimum requirements and ratings.
requirements.text: Technical specifications outline minimum requirements and ratings.

requirements.quote: The following Standards and Codes in effect as of the date of this specification, and any subsections thereof as applicable, shall govern design and selection of equipment and material supplied:
requirements.text: Design and selection must comply with listed standards and codes.

requirements.quote: IEEE C37.20.2 – Standard for Metal-Clad Switchgear
requirements.text: Comply with IEEE C37.20.2 standard for metal-clad switchgear.

requirements.quote: IEEE C37.100.1 – Standard of Common Requirements for High-Voltage Power Switchgear Rated Above 1000 V
requirements.text: Comply with IEEE C37.100.1 standard for high-voltage power switchgear.

requirements.quote: ANSI Z535.4 – American National Standard for Product Safety Signs and Labels
requirements.text: Comply with ANSI Z535.4 standard for product safety signs and labels.

requirements.quote: ASTM (American Society for Testing and Materials)
